card_fire_01.name: Inferno Ring
card_fire_01.description: Keeps Burning Aura and releases a large fire ring every 3 seconds for 150% ATK before DEF.

card_fire_02.name: Twin Strikes
card_fire_02.description: Each melee attack hits twice, each dealing 75% of a regular hit after DEF. Volatile Imp is unchanged.

card_fire_03.name: Greater Fireball
card_fire_03.description: Larger fireballs splash a medium radius for 60% ATK around the enemy hit.

card_fire_04.name: Scorched Ground
card_fire_04.description: Dragonfire keeps its burn and leaves a large fire field for 5 seconds, dealing 20% ATK each second. One ground field per Dragon; a new hit replaces it.

card_fire_05.name: Last Ember
card_fire_05.description: On death, restores 30% Max HP to living allies in a large radius.

card_fire_06.name: Lasting Embers
card_fire_06.description: A fire trail remains until two later fireball arrivals. If its owner dies, it fades within 10 seconds. Each trail damages an enemy once per tick.

card_water_01.name: Ice Splinters
card_water_01.description: Each normal attack has a seeded 20% chance to burst ice in a small radius around its target for 75% ATK before DEF.

card_water_02.name: Twin Heads
card_water_02.description: Two heads attack at twice the normal rate, each shot dealing 70% of a regular hit after DEF. The Attack Speed rating cap still applies.

card_water_03.name: Deeper Puddles
card_water_03.description: Healing Puddle restores 5.5% Max HP per tick instead of 5%: a relative 10% healing increase.

card_water_04.name: Crashing Tide
card_water_04.description: Shots push enemies a moderate distance and slow movement by 20% for 1 second.

card_water_05.name: Shell Breaker
card_water_05.description: Every third attack deals 200% ATK before DEF instead of 160%.

card_water_06.name: Riptide
card_water_06.description: Water gush pushes enemies a large distance and slows their movement by 20% for 1 second. Each enemy is hit once per gush.

card_earth_01.name: Ancient Canopy
card_earth_01.description: Grows 20% larger visually and increases the healing aura radius by 25%.

card_earth_02.name: Binding Vines
card_earth_02.description: Vine Pull roots the pulled enemy for 2 seconds. Root blocks walking and starting a backline transit, but permits attacking and forced displacement.

card_earth_03.name: Relentless Maul
card_earth_03.description: Consecutive melee strikes on the same target gain 5% damage per strike, up to 50%. Switching targets resets the bonus. Maul still empowers every third hit.

card_earth_04.name: Double Loose
card_earth_04.description: Each attack fires two arrows, each dealing 75% of a regular hit after DEF.

card_earth_05.name: Armor Spores
card_earth_05.description: Direct hits reduce the target’s DEF by 3% per stack, up to 30%. Stacks last 5 seconds after the latest hit and are shared across allied Spore Sages.

card_earth_06.name: Upheaval
card_earth_06.description: Each normal attack has a seeded 15% chance to knock its enemy back a small distance. Cracks still block displacement.

card_slime_01.name: Jelly Family
card_slime_01.description: Small slimes split once more into two tiny slimes each, with 50% of their parent’s HP and ATK. Two split generations maximum; revived parents never split a second time.

card_slime_02.name: Clinging Shots
card_slime_02.description: Direct hits also reduce Attack Speed by 5% per stack, up to 30%, for 5 seconds after the latest hit. The ordinary splash slow remains.

card_slime_03.name: Corrosive Jelly
card_slime_03.description: On death, leaves a large field for 5 seconds that reduces enemy DEF by 20% while inside. Overlapping corrosive fields do not stack.

card_slime_04.name: Clogging Spill
card_slime_04.description: The death explosion and damaging pool remain. A large field also slows enemies inside by 15% for 10 seconds; overlapping fields do not stack.

card_slime_05.name: Last Remedy
card_slime_05.description: On death, leaves a large healing pool for 5 seconds, restoring 10% Max HP each second to allies inside. Overlapping Last Remedy pools heal once per tick.

card_slime_06.name: Final Bond
card_slime_06.description: On death, links all enemies within a medium radius for 5 seconds. Hits to one share 25% of actual damage with each linked partner. Shared damage cannot share again; overlapping links use the strongest share per partner.
